#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=42
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/allenai/OLMo-1B-hf"
SCORER_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2___5-1___5B-Instruct"
SEED_DATA="data/code_python_seed"
DATA_DIR="data/exp_code_olmo"
RESULTS_DIR="results/exp_code_olmo"

# Verify models exist
if [ ! -d "$MODEL_PATH" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: OLMo-1B not found at $MODEL_PATH"
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "$SCORER_PATH" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Scorer not found at $SCORER_PATH"
    exit 1
fi

# Create data dir and symlink seed
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"
if [ ! -e "${DATA_DIR}/depth_0.jsonl" ]; then
    ln -s "$(pwd)/${SEED_DATA}/depth_0.jsonl" "${DATA_DIR}/depth_0.jsonl"
fi

echo "=== exp_code_olmo: OLMo-1B Code domain depth chain ==="
echo "Generator: $MODEL_PATH"
echo "Scorer:    $SCORER_PATH"
echo "Seed:      $SEED_DATA"
echo "Data:      $DATA_DIR"
echo "Results:   $RESULTS_DIR"
echo "GPU:       CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
echo ""

# Phase 1: Generate depth chain with OLMo-1B
echo "=== Phase 1: Generating depth chain with OLMo-1B ==="
python scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
  --results_dir "$RESULTS_DIR" \
  --num_samples 5500 \
  --max_depth 5 \
  --batch_size 16 \
  --feat_batch_size 8 \
  --generation_mode continuation

echo ""
echo "=== Phase 1 complete. Depth chain generated. ==="
echo ""

# Phase 2: Cross-score with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
echo "=== Phase 2: Cross-scoring with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ==="
rm -f "${DATA_DIR}/features.csv"

python scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --model_path "$SCORER_PATH" \
  --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
  --results_dir "$RESULTS_DIR" \
  --num_samples 5500 \
  --max_depth 5 \
  --batch_size 16 \
  --feat_batch_size 8 \
  --generation_mode continuation \
  --skip_generation

echo ""
echo "=== DONE: exp_code_olmo complete ==="
echo "Results in: $RESULTS_DIR"
EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination/scripts/run_code_olmo1b.sh
cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && nohup bash scripts/run_code_olmo1b.sh > results/exp_code_olmo.log 2>&1 & echo "PID=$!"
